description: This file contains TypeScript code defining types, functions, and logic for managing Discord thread channels, including creation, resolution, caching, and message handling within a Discord integration for a larger application.

classes.name: DiscordThreadChannel
classes.description: Represents a Discord thread channel with properties like id, name, parentId, parent info, and ownerId.

classes.name: DiscordThreadStarter
classes.description: Represents the starter message of a Discord thread, including text, author info, roles, and timestamp.

classes.name: DiscordThreadParentInfo
classes.description: Contains information about the parent channel of a Discord thread, including id, name, and type.

classes.name: DiscordThreadStarterRestEmbed
classes.description: Represents an embed object in a Discord message, with optional title and description.

classes.name: DiscordThreadStarterRestSnapshotMessage
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of a Discord message, including content, attachments, embeds, and stickers.

classes.name: DiscordThreadStarterRestAuthor
classes.description: Contains author details such as id, username, and discriminator.

classes.name: DiscordThreadStarterRestMember
classes.description: Represents a Discord member with optional nickname, display name, and roles.

classes.name: DiscordThreadStarterRestMessage
classes.description: Represents a Discord message with content, embeds, message snapshots, member info, author info, and timestamp.

classes.name: DiscordReplyDeliveryPlan
classes.description: Defines the delivery plan for replies, including target, reply target, and reply reference.

classes.name: DiscordAutoThreadContext
classes.description: Context information for an automatically created Discord thread, including IDs and session keys.

classes.name: DiscordAutoThreadReplyPlan
classes.description: Extends reply plan with auto thread context and created thread ID.

methods.name: __resetDiscordThreadStarterCacheForTest
methods.description: Clears the thread starter cache, used for testing.

methods.name: getCachedThreadStarter
methods.description: Retrieves a cached thread starter with TTL validation and LRU update.

methods.name: setCachedThreadStarter
methods.description: Sets a thread starter in cache with LRU eviction policy.

methods.name: isDiscordThreadType
methods.description: Checks if a channel type is a Discord thread type.

methods.name: isDiscordForumParentType
methods.description: Checks if a parent channel type is a Discord forum or media type.

methods.name: resolveTrimmedDiscordMessageChannelId
methods.description: Resolves and trims the message channel ID from message or parameter.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadChannel
methods.description: Resolves the Discord thread channel object from message and channel info.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadParentInfo
methods.description: Fetches and returns parent info for a Discord thread.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadStarter
methods.description: Fetches and constructs the starter info for a Discord thread, with caching.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadStarterMessageChannelId
methods.description: Determines the message channel ID for a thread starter based on parent type.

methods.name: fetchDiscordThreadStarterMessage
methods.description: Fetches the thread starter message from Discord API.

methods.name: buildDiscordThreadStarterPayload
methods.description: Builds a thread starter object from API message data.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadStarterText
methods.description: Extracts text content from a thread starter message.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadStarterIdentity
methods.description: Resolves identity info (author, roles) for a thread starter message.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadStarterAuthor
methods.description: Determines the author name from a thread starter message.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadStarterAuthorTag
methods.description: Constructs author tag (username#discriminator) if available.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadStarterRoleIds
methods.description: Extracts role IDs from a member object.

methods.name: resolveDiscordReplyTarget
methods.description: Determines reply target based on reply mode and reply ID.

methods.name: sanitizeDiscordThreadName
methods.description: Cleans and truncates a raw thread name, removing mentions and whitespace.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAutoThreadContext
methods.description: Creates context info for an auto-created thread, including session keys.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAutoThreadReplyPlan
methods.description: Generates a reply plan with auto thread creation and context.

methods.name: maybeCreateDiscordAutoThread
methods.description: Creates a Discord thread automatically if conditions are met.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadTitleModelRef
methods.description: Resolves model reference for thread title override based on config.

methods.name: maybeRenameDiscordAutoThread
methods.description: Renames a Discord thread based on generated title if different.

methods.name: resolveDiscordReplyDeliveryPlan
methods.description: Determines how to deliver a reply, possibly routing to a new thread.

methods.name: resolveStarterForwardedText
methods.description: Extracts text from forwarded message snapshots for thread starter info.
